text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had an excellent experience at this physiotherapy clinic. I visited for two sessions because I was struggling with back pain, and the improvement was remarkable.
The therapist was very professional, knowledgeable, and attentive. She quickly identified that my issue was related to my rhomboid muscle, which had become weak due to my posture. She clearly explained the problem and guided me through effective exercises to strengthen the muscle.
What I appreciated the most was how much time she dedicated to my treatment. Even though it wasn’t necessarily included in the standard session, she took extra time to carefully assess my condition and make sure I was improving. You could really tell that she genuinely cared about helping me get better.
In addition, she used therapeutic treatments (including ultrasound/electrotherapy), which really helped relieve the pain. After just two sessions, my back pain was almost completely gone.
I also appreciated how she made sure I understood what to do going forward, so I can continue improving on my own.
Highly recommended for anyone dealing with similar issues!
